description: NIST SP 800-53 security controls mapped to network device configurations

rules.name: Account Management — Ensure local user accounts are configured with least privilege

remediation.cisco_ios:
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local

rules.name: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts — Ensure login lockout is configured

remediation.generic: Configure automatic lockout after repeated failed login attempts.

rules.name: Remote Access — Ensure only secure remote access protocols are used

remediation.cisco_ios:
ip ssh version 2
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
remediation.generic: Use SSH version 2 for all remote management. Disable Telnet.

rules.name: Audit Events — Ensure logging is enabled

remediation.generic: Enable audit logging to a centralized syslog server.

rules.name: Content of Audit Records — Ensure log timestamps are enabled

remediation.generic: Include timestamps in all audit records.

rules.name: Identification and Authentication — Ensure encrypted passwords

remediation.generic: Enable password encryption to protect stored credentials.
Set minimum password length to at least 8 characters.

rules.name: Transmission Confidentiality — Ensure Telnet is disabled

remediation.generic: Disable Telnet to protect transmission confidentiality.

rules.name: Cryptographic Protection — Ensure SNMPv3 is used

remediation.cisco_ios:
snmp-server group SNMPV3GRP v3 priv
snmp-server user <user> SNMPV3GRP v3 auth sha <key> priv aes 256 <key>
remediation.generic: Migrate to SNMPv3 with authentication and encryption.

rules.name: Least Functionality — Ensure unnecessary services are disabled

remediation.cisco_ios:
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
remediation.generic: Disable all unnecessary services (HTTP, finger, CDP).
